mapper.sql: m.id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.material_type, m.category_id, m.unit, m.spec, m.model, m.brand, m.barcode, m.safety_stock, m.purchase_price, m.sale_price, m.tax_rate, m.status, m.remark, m.external_code, m.source_system, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, c.category_name AS category_name, du.dict_label AS unit_name, dt.dict_label AS material_type_name, ds.dict_label AS status_name

LEFT JOIN mdm_material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data du ON du.dict_type = 'mdm_unit' AND du.dict_value = m.unit AND du.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dt ON dt.dict_type = 'mdm_material_type' AND dt.dict_value = m.material_type AND dt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data ds ON ds.dict_type = 'sys_normal_disable' AND ds.dict_value = m.status AND ds.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM mdm_material m
m.is_deleted = 0
AND m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.materialCode}, '%')
AND m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.materialName}, '%')
AND m.material_type = #{q.materialType}
AND (m.category_id = #{q.categoryId} OR m.category_id IN ( SELECT id FROM mdm_material_category WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (id = #{q.categoryId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{q.categoryId}, ancestors)) ))
AND m.status = #{q.status}
ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, du.dict_label AS unit_name, m.spec, m.model, m.purchase_price, m.tax_rate, m.status FROM mdm_material m LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data du ON du.dict_type = 'mdm_unit' AND du.dict_value = m.unit AND du.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = '0'
AND (m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.material_code ASC LIMIT 50
